summary: Authenticated New Reward admin access previously reached the Air Express setup record, PR #3834 is merged/deployed, and PR #4105 is now merged/deployed for the GSC/GA4/GBP bearer-token proxy path. The latest read-only configured NewRewards production env lookup still finds the Air Express client, tenant, canonical primary website id cmorqbs9j001r5nr1h25vosp8, non-primary website records, and GSC/GA4 provider credential and connection rows under newrewardplatform@gmail.com. The blocker is now narrower: GSC and GA4 rows exist for the canonical live website id, but both are expired; GA4 propertyId is null; the local Google token lacks webmasters.readonly, analytics.readonly, and business.manage; GBP location/provider proof is still missing; the live homepage still lacks the GA4/GTM marker and /analytics.js is 404; and the live SEO workspace/provider UI still needs a fresh authenticated recheck after the #4105 deployment.
rootCause: There are now separate confirmed breaks. First, the platform bearer-token forwarding path was repaired by NewRewards PR #4105, so missing bearer-token behavior should be retested from an authenticated New Reward app session. Second, the corrected read-only NewRewards source proves the canonical client and website mapping exists, but GSC and GA4 provider rows for cmorqbs9j001r5nr1h25vosp8 are expired and GA4 propertyId is null. Third, local Google credentials for newrewardplatform@gmail.com have identity/cloud/admin scopes but lack Search Console, GA4, and Business Profile read scopes. Fourth, owned-site delivery automation is not wired or is manual-required, so the local GA4 source is not live. Fifth, no approved Air Express GTM container id has been found. Sixth, no full ServiceTitan lead/revenue export is joined yet.
blocker: Air Express GSC/GA4/GBP direct history cannot be loaded yet because the available Google token lacks required read scopes, the New Reward GSC/GA4 provider rows for canonical website cmorqbs9j001r5nr1h25vosp8 are expired, GA4 propertyId is null, GBP location/provider proof is still missing, live delivery has not synced the local GA4 source, and ServiceTitan lead/revenue history is still not joined. This is not evidence that the Google assets do not exist; it is an access, scope, property-selection, live-delivery, and revenue-join blocker.
